title: france_students_short
question: Would you join them? Comment below!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: More than *two hundred sixty thousand* high school students just marched across France.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Fifty six thousand in Paris alone.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It started at *one school* outside Paris, and spread across the country in two weeks.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Why? Classes of up to *thirty five* students. Teachers who are never replaced.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Crumbling ceilings, *rats*, and classrooms that hit forty degrees in the heat.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: One student went *seven months* without a French teacher, in a year with a French exam.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Police answered with *tear gas*. More than six thousand arrested, most of them minors.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: One fifteen year old *lost a hand* to a police grenade.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Some schools were even *set on fire*. Hundreds were closed.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: We don't feel listened to at all, one student said. *We're the future*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Students want *ten billion euros* for education. The government is offering far less.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Would you protest for better schools? *Tell us in the comments*.
